Name: Nord
Description: Citizens of Skyrim, they are a tall and fair-haired people. Strong and hardy, Nords are famous for their resistance to cold. They are highly talented warriors.
Origins:
Western: You lived in the west of Skyrim, a rugged environment filled with rough terrain and dangerous beasts. You are prepared to survive in even the most challenging climates.

Eastern: Either due to extreme snowstorms, the College of Mages or simply stubbornness, the people of Eastern Skyrim, such as you, are known for their tenacity and resourcefulness.
